name: security-review-r9dcbr
goal: Find defensive code-review candidates from committed security bug classes, revalidate them under per-run caps, and prepare one red/green loop per confirmed finding.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Acceptance: committed pattern lists and attack-surface starter; read-only sibling matching; separate revalidation against the pinned source; confirmed-only handoff to one bug-fix loop per site; shared per-run wall deadline and pre-reserved reviewer cost; synthetic CLI proof without provider calls.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Security CLI reuses committed sibling-sweep candidates, supports a separately attested review, caps evaluator admission and execution, and creates one confirmed-only bug-fix loop per site.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: 11 focused unit tests and all 9 loop CLI E2Es passed on the first implementation snapshot. Exact-commit verification and additional repair/budget assertions are pending the final run.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
